fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League Military has long fielded some of the largest infantry formations in the Inner Sphere, with regiments numbering nearly 1,800 soldiers compared to roughly 750 in the Combine and just over 1,000 in the Federated Suns. Foot infantry platoons form the garrison backbone of the League's provincial militaries, assigned to hold ground on worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Quality varies with provincial investment, but even modest foot platoons benefit from the FWLM's tradition of equipping infantry with reliable, standardized kit. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
